description: High-density ERPs during masking with finely varied target-mask intervals: considerable subliminal processing occurs early in the occipito-temporal pathway (under 250 ms), and a late (over 270 ms), highly distributed fronto-parieto-temporal activation correlates with conscious report.

sources.quote: pointing to a late (>270 ms) and highly distributed fronto-parieto-temporal activation as a correlate of conscious reportability.
